long_description:
Description:
A fork of the Scratch Version of Nate Pong, built on the Scratch Everywhere! runtime. Based on Tux,the mascot for Linux,and Konqi,the mascot for KDE.
Installation:
Download the latest .cia/.3dsx file from the Releases.
For .3dsx files,just put it in your 3ds folder on your 3DS SD Card,then launch it with the Homebrew Launcher.
For .cia files,just put it on your cias folder on your 3DS SD Card,then installit via FBI,or your preferred CIA installer, then a package should appear in your home menu after installing,open it! Then launch the Tux Pong game.
Credits & Licensing:
Game made by: effL
Based on: Dogo2009/Dogo6647/htlabs's port of Nate Pong (Nate Pong: Scratch Edition) on Scratch and on Scratch Everywhere,NateXS runtime to run Scratch games on consoles.
Tux character originally drawn by Larry Ewing with the GIMP. Konqi Character originally drawn by Stefan Spatz, redrawn by Timothée Giet and by Tyson Tan.
Music and SFX by OpenGameArt
The Original Nate Pong is created by NateXS and its licensed under the MIT license,see LICENSE-MIT on the official repository page for more details.
